name: Crossing House
invitation: An open court, a low ramp, and a screen you can move. Try sending a line above the screen, around it, or back across the court. Keep a route you would like to change.
physicalQuestion: Can one small arrangement invite different routes: a ramp-assisted carry, a cross-court return, and an optional second use of the same ramp? What does one turn or slide of the screen change?
nearbySensitivity: At the over-screen example all 8 adjacent yaw, elevation, charge and origin probes retain ramp then far face. At across-court all 8 retain screen then west; 4 also retain east. The longer second-visit line retains all 4 contacts for 3 of 8 immediate neighbours; its elevation and charge neighbours shorten or bypass the later contacts. A 5-degree screen turn can shorten a cross-court line, whereas either 0.5 m lateral slide retains its three contacts. Numerical setups and raw evidence stay in the appendix.
validationEvidence: Actual Havok at 120 Hz through the unchanged Worldcraft runtime; tested terminals replay through scripts/foundry/validate.mjs. The reproduction script records contacts, callback normals and pre-step and post-step velocities, sampled actual paths, neighbours, geometry-ablation controls and 20 load-fire-reset-switch cycles. The wing contacts are their inner end faces; the long route uses the rear and side of the ramp. NullEngine does not establish visual readability, frame timing or enjoyment.

limitations.concept: A compact open court whose ramp, screen and wings invite distinct route choices.
limitations.missing: The browser in this session cannot create WebGL; visibility and control comfort at desktop and phone size remain unverified.
limitations.extension: Rendered owner review before changing cameras or adding more pieces.

limitations.concept: The repeated use of the same ramp remains an optional discovery.
limitations.missing: The longer return has narrow elevation and power tolerance despite adjacent yaw solutions; its later ramp contacts are rear and side contacts, not top landings.
limitations.extension: Do not turn it into a required challenge; evaluate whether its surprise is worth retaining during free play.
